I count the falling stars.
I count the small breaths.

I count the soft light.

I make space for stillness.
I make space for tomorrow.
I make space for love.
I make space for hope.
I let the worries go.
I let the shadows fall.
I close my eyes now.
Sleep comes like gentle rain.
